verdict.rationale: Weaviate's GitHub README says the product itself combines search with reranking in a single query interface, so a native rerank capability exists. However, nothing in the pack names any built-in or first-party-integrated reranker models or shows how to configure them. The hybrid fusion strategies (relativeScoreFusion/rankedFusion) are score combination, not model-based reranking, so they are not credited. Missing for 10: documentation of specific reranker model integrations, rerank query configuration details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can rerank search results with built-in or first-party-integrated reranking models

citations.quote: It combines vector similarity search with keyword filtering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and reranking in a single query interface.
